title: Ukraine says Starlink, Starshield connections return to normal speeds
summary_full: Ukraine's satellite communication systems, Starlink and Starshield, have returned to operational speeds above 400 km/h. These systems are critical for military communications and operation, particularly against Russian attacks. Previously reported disruptions had severely impacted Ukraine's capabilities to intercept threats and maintain logistics. Defence Minister Evhenii Khmara emphasized the importance of the restored speeds for military efforts.
